propositions: No Jira Data Center trial license or official OpenAPI spec exists, so a DC adapter cannot be verified against a real instance without a purpose-built harness.
The harness must BUILD a vendored Dockerfile from the addono base pinned by digest, not pull an unpublished pycontribs image, and atlas-run downloads Jira 8.17.1 from maven.atlassian.com at runtime.

The vendored entrypoint must keep -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout, because removing either causes silent cold-start failures (retired Marketplace endpoint and Cargo's 600000ms deploy ceiling).

The harness runs only in the external tier under tests/external/live_jira_dc, gated by REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL opt-in, skipping (not failing) when absent, with a canary that fails a run collecting jira_live tests but executing none.
Live acceptance requires a native amd64 runner via external-integration.yml, since emulated arm64 hosts never reach usable Jira startup even with timeouts lifted.
Smoke tests prove REST v2 issue create/read-back, programmatic PAT bearer authentication, index-independent teardown via direct issue 404s, and a fresh-instance guard rejecting leftover residue.
